items.say: Boo the ghost set off for the snowy hills with a potion, an egg, a coin, and a flag. On the way, he dropped the potion in a puddle, but he fished it out. Later, he left the egg on a rock and never found it again. In the end, Boo had to turn back. Why did Boo have to turn back?

Pounce the cat had a birthday party. Puff the dragon gave her a mushroom, and she jumped for joy. Sir Clank the knight gave her a shield, and she just yawned. Zip the robot gave her a map, and she said a quiet thank you. Which present did Pounce like best?

At midnight, the whole castle was asleep. Boo the ghost crept down the hall to find a snack. First, he bumped into a potion, and it fell over with a loud crash. Then he stepped over an egg without a sound. After that, he slipped past a sword very quietly. Soon everyone was wide awake. Which thing woke everyone up?

Pounce the cat was on her way to the village fair. She stopped to play with a shield for a whole hour. Then she looked at a mushroom for just one second. After that, she walked right past a crown without stopping. When she got there at last, everyone had gone home. Why was Pounce so late?
